|game_text=If you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 2. Whenever you lose Force during opponent's control phase (except from a Force drain at a battleground or your card) that loss is cumulatively -1 (to a minimum of 1). Non-[Virtual Block 4] [[Imperial Atrocity (V){{!}}Imperial Atrocity]] is canceled.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Imperial Atrocity (V)]]; it is the current text. No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB4-85-Imperial_Atrocity-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-imperialatrocity-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-85-Imperial_Atrocity.png]]) show the original text (see [[Imperial Atrocity (V)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Imperial Atrocity (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip 85)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=10 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found), page 10, slip 85. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=10 Internet Archive]</ref>: “If you are about to lose Force during opponent’s control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 2. Whenever you lose Force during opponent’s control phase (except from a Force drain at a battleground or your card) that loss is cumulatively -1 (to a minimum of 1).” The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed the same text.<ref name="cl-1240_86-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) added “Non-[Virtual Block 4] Imperial Atrocity is canceled.” (slip marked E): “If you are about to lose Force during opponent’s control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 2. Whenever you lose Force during opponent’s control phase (except from a Force drain at a battleground or your card) that loss is cumulatively -1 (to a minimum of 1). Non-[Virtual Block 4] Imperial Atrocity is canceled.”<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=25, page 25. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=25 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 14 June 2013, effective immediately, as a “repost of recent errata from the CBT” (the first announcement has not been found)<ref name="pcforum-p813434">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 14 June 2013 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p813434 forum post])</ref>, so this version was in force by 14 June 2013. The Master List that prints it was compiled until February 2014, so its 27 April 2013 date does not date this change.
